data.name: Surjo
data.gender_notes: Surjo is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Surjo is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Surya’, which means ‘Sun’. The name is a tribute to the Hindu Sun God, Surya, who is revered for his power, strength, and ability to provide light and warmth. The name Surjo carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali, Assamese. Parents who choose Surjo usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Surjo signifies enlightenment, radiance, and the divine presence of the Sun God. It is believed that individuals with this name possess a strong connection to the divine and are blessed with the power of the Sun.
data.etymology: Surjo belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Surjo total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Surjo carries a rich cultural heritage within the Hindu community. It is a powerful, evocative name that resonates with the transcendent power of the Sun God. In Hindu mythology, Surya is depicted as a divine warrior riding his chariot across the sky. His name is often invoked for protection, strength, and vitality. The name Surjo would be interpreted as a beacon of hope, a symbol of power and resilience, and a reminder of the divine presence of the Sun God that pervades the universe.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the Sun God is considered one of the most auspicious and revered deities. He is the embodiment of spiritual power and illumination. The name Surjo holds spiritual significance as it signifies the divine light and knowledge that shines within us, guiding us through the intricacies of life. It is a reminder to seek enlightenment and to keep the flame of spiritual understanding burning brightly within oneself. Overall, the name Surjo represents the indomitable spirit and the divine guidance that leads us towards a life filled with meaning and purpose.
